teleology: Capture the single-name equity tape at T-n so downstream reasoning can anchor on realized price, volatility, and momentum state rather than narrative summaries.
mechanism: Runs tools.stock.stock over the curated equity universe and writes a normalized STOCK table with category, identity, price, volatility, horizon returns, and z-score fields.
expectation: Return a STOCK artifact over the curated equity universe with Category, Ticker, Identity, Price, Vol_20d, Chg_5d, Chg_63d, Z_Short, and Z_Long. No ETF instruments and no missing required columns.
